raw_row.name: Aditya bangde
raw_row.What's your level of experience with rob: I’d consider myself at an intermediate level. I have hands-on experience with ROS and SLAM, and I’ve worked on integrating hardware and software for embodied AI systems. Recently, I’ve been working on integrating the SO-100 robot with an ACT model.  I’m also training neural networks for a prosthetic leg project based on the University of Michigan’s Open Source Leg (OSL). In addition, I’ve trained a PPO-based controller for a bipedal robot and deployed it on an STM32 microcontroller using TensorFlow Lite.  I’m comfortable with system integration, control, and deploying ML models on embedded hardware, and I’m currently expanding into more advanced areas of robotics and learning-based control.
